# Ultimate Chunk Limiter
A Plugin that helps to Limit Entity per chunk. Auto Cleanup, Per Chunk Limit, Whitelist Entities, Tamed/Named Entity Option, Whitelist Worlds, & more...

## Features:
- Check Loaded Chunk every few time (Time can edit in Config)
- Limit Spawn every Chunk (Limit can edit in Config)
- Whitelist Entities (Edit in Config)
- Option to enable/disable Kill of Tamed/Named Entity
- Option to enable Auto Cleanup/Entity Limit
- Very optimised take 0.02% to 2% only.

Made With Help of AI.
Only for Server Use not for resale or show as own product.
